# fyre_quota (Data Source)

Fetches quota information for the authenticated user, including IP quotas, available platforms, product group details, and platform-specific resource quotas (CPU, memory, disk).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `details` (Attributes) Quota details including IP, platforms, and resource quotas (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--details))
- `id` (String) The quota identifier
- `status` (String) API response status

<a id="nestedatt--details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `details`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (Attributes) IP quota information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--details--ip))
- `platforms` (List of String) List of available platforms
- `product_group_id` (Number) Product group identifier
- `product_group_name` (String) Product group name
- `x` (Attributes) X platform resource quotas (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--details--x))

<a id="nestedatt--details--ip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `details.ip`

Read-Only:

- `public` (Attributes) Public IP quota details (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--details--ip--public))

<a id="nestedatt--details--ip--public"></a>
### Nested Schema for `details.ip.public`

Read-Only:

- `quota` (Number) Total public IP quota
- `used` (Number) Number of public IPs currently in use



<a id="nestedatt--details--x"></a>
### Nested Schema for `details.x`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Total CPU quota
- `cpu_percent` (Number) CPU usage percentage
- `cpu_used` (Number) Number of CPUs currently in use
- `disk` (Number) Total disk quota in GB
- `disk_percent` (Number) Disk usage percentage
- `disk_used` (Number) Disk space currently in use in GB
- `memory` (Number) Total memory quota in GB
- `memory_percent` (Number) Memory usage percentage
- `memory_used` (Number) Memory currently in use in GB
